component.name: Browsrl
component.summary: A small local-first browser shell for GTK desktops

description.p: Browsrl is a GTK4 and WebKitGTK 6.0 browser shell built around a strict navigation boundary and a single local profile directory.

ul.li: Tabs with lazy WebView creation, so an unselected tab costs no renderer
Private tabs on an ephemeral network session, never restored or recorded
Bookmarks and browsing history in one local SQLite profile
Downloads confined to the profile with sanitised file names
No telemetry, no account, no sync, and no update client

description.p: First slice: tabs, navigation boundary, private tabs, bookmarks, history, downloads and a readability pass.
